accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.description: Stack of show/hide sections on Base UI. One-open-at-a-time or multiple. Token-only, hairline dividers.

alert.title: Alert
alert.description: Soft inline feedback block for product messages, warnings, and recoverable errors.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: User picture with initials/icon fallback, on Base UI Avatar. Sizes, status badge, and stacked groups.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Compact status/metadata pill for dense product UI surfaces and repeated rows.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: Navigation trail for nested pages. Semantic markup, polymorphic links via render, collapsed middle, custom separators.

button.title: Button
button.description: Primary interactive control built on Base UI. Token-only styling, ≥44px touch targets, polymorphic via the render prop.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Single-date calendar grid and popover date picker for form dates and lightweight filters.

card.title: Card
card.description: A borderless content surface for grouping related information and actions.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Boolean toggle with an indeterminate state, built on Base UI. Token-only.

code.title: Code
code.description: Inline code token and lightweight copyable code block for snippets, commands, and generated examples.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.description: Single show/hide region on Base UI with a smooth height animation. Token-only, borderless.

combobox.title: Combobox
combobox.description: Searchable select on Base UI Combobox — type to filter a large list. Token-only, empty state, keyboard nav.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: Modal dialog primitives for focused workflows, plus AlertDialog parts for required confirmations.

dropdown-menu.title: Dropdown menu
dropdown-menu.description: A compact action menu for overflow controls, short navigation lists, and simple choices.

empty-state.title: Empty state
empty-state.description: A calm fallback block for empty collections, filtered results, and first-run setup.

feedback-state.title: Feedback state
feedback-state.description: Status-driven block for a region — loading, error, success, info/pending — in page, panel or inline layouts. Built on Base UI, token-only.

field.title: Field
field.description: Labelled form field on Base UI Field — auto-wires label, description, error, and invalid state to the control.

input.title: Input
input.description: Styled text input on Base UI — ≥44px, token-only, invalid state via aria-invalid.

label.title: Label
label.description: A styled label. Associate with a control via htmlFor. Polymorphic via render.

list.title: List
list.description: Composable repeated rows for queues, settings, files, activity, and compact summaries.

md-view.title: MD view
md-view.description: Document/report shell with GFM markdown rendering, metadata, actions, and a reusable content viewport.

page-shell.title: Page shell
page-shell.description: Composable page content scaffold for width, rhythm, sticky controls, intro copy, sections, and back navigation.

pill.title: Pill
pill.description: Interactive filter and sort chips for lightweight view controls.

popover.title: Popover
popover.description: An anchored interactive surface for short forms, selectors, and rich contextual help.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Determinate/indeterminate progress bar on Base UI. Sizes, optional label+value, turns positive at 100%.

radio-group.title: Radio group
radio-group.description: Single-choice form control for mutually exclusive options, with compact radios and clickable option rows.

select.title: Select
select.description: Accessible single-choice listbox in a portal, built on Base UI. Token-only.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: A subtle structural divider for grouping related content without adding another surface.

sheet.title: Sheet
sheet.description: A modal edge panel for mobile navigation, selectors, and compact side workflows.

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Decorative loading placeholder for content that is still being fetched or prepared.

slider.title: Slider
slider.description: Pick a number or a range by dragging, on Base UI Slider. Single or two-thumb, token-only, ≥44px touch control.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: Instant on/off toggle, built on Base UI. Token-only.

table.title: Table
table.description: Composable native table parts for dense, scannable data comparison.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Accessible tabbed navigation for switching between related content panels.

textarea.title: Textarea
textarea.description: Multi-line text field that auto-grows — same focus/invalid treatment as Input.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: Transient auto-dismissing feedback on Base UI Toast. Sonner-like toast() API, typed (success/error/info), Alert-like visuals.

toggle-group.title: Toggle group
toggle-group.description: Pressed buttons and segmented controls for toolbar state, display modes, and compact choices.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Short, non-interactive help popup for icon buttons, compact labels, and unfamiliar controls.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Heading, Text and Eyebrow — the closed text scale. Token-only, polymorphic via render.
